title: Shopping centre announcement
instructions: Alışveriş merkezinde kısa bir anons. Kısa ama her bilgi önemli. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Hello, shoppers. The car park on level two is full.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: Please use level three or four.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The toilets on the ground floor are closed. Please use the toilets on the first floor.

script.speaker: voice
script.text: The shopping centre closes in thirty minutes, at eight.

questions.prompt: Which car park level is full?
questions.evidence: The car park on level two is full.

questions.feedback: Üçüncü ya da dördüncü katı kullanabilirler.
questions.evidence: Please use level three or four.

questions.feedback: Zemin kattaki tuvaletler kapalı; birinci katta açık.
questions.evidence: Please use the toilets on the first floor.

questions.prompt: What time does the shopping centre close?
questions.feedback: Otuz dakika sonra, saat sekizde kapanıyor.
Otuz dakika sonra sekiz olacak; şu an yedi buçuk.
